runtime_measurement.limitations: Release 优化 + DEBUG 编译条件以启用虚构数据/本地 relay；运行资源来自此隔离包，包体来自原样 Release；不代表商店包或真机资源。

speed.method: launch command issued -> App os_log "lane-ready" (first data-bearing screen), App terminated 3 s before each run, first run after install discarded, median

idle.method: shared measure.py idle: CPU-time delta / wall window; phys_footprint peak of 3 samples after the window
idle.scope: Simulator App host process only; excludes CoreSimulator, system services and inactive extensions
